descriptionHtml:
Skutt Kiln Full Set of Replacement Elements

A complete set of replacement heating elements for Skutt KM, KMT and KS (KilnSitter) pottery kilns. Choose your kiln model, voltage and phase to get every element your kiln needs in one order, in Skutt's standard elements or long-life APM elements.

Before you order:

  • Match the model, voltage and phase on your kiln's serial plate (on the control box). If you're not sure, send us the serial plate info or a photo with your order.
  • APM elements are engineered to last longer in kilns that fire to high temperatures with long hold times.
  • Wired-ring kilns (WR, and -27 on older models) have 2 extra elements, and the 145 WR has 1 extra. Those sets are listed separately and include the extra elements.
  • KS818, KS818-3 and KS818P-3: since October 1, 2017 these kilns use the same elements as the matching KM818 models. If your kiln was built before then and you're replacing ALL the elements, Skutt suggests the KM818 set. WR kilns and single-element replacements must use the old design.
